name: tab
description: Classes that style a row of links or buttons as tab navigation. CSS only: no panels, no state, and no keyboard handling.

props.disabled: Add tab--disabled by hand, and set tabindex="-1" so the Tab key skips it.
props.size: Add tab--small or tab--large to each tab. Large is the default.

modifiers.tab--small: Shorter padding, smaller text, and a thinner indicator. Set on each tab
modifiers.tab--large: The default size. Set on each tab
modifiers.tab--active: The selected tab. Draws the indicator line under it
modifiers.tab--disabled: Lowers opacity and turns off pointer events

customPropertiesNote: Public variables use the --_op-tab-* prefix and are set on .tab. The size modifiers copy them into private --__op-tab-* variables. Colors, background, hover, and focus come straight from global tokens and have no tab variable.

tab.--_op-tab-font-large: Text size for tab--large and the default
tab.--_op-tab-padding-large: Padding for tab--large and the default
tab.--_op-tab-indicator-width-small: Thickness of the active line for tab--small
tab.--_op-tab-indicator-width-large: Thickness of the active line for tab--large and the default
